jei.focal_decay.source.rose: Complete a model training at the Training Terminal for the first time
jei.focal_decay.source.throne: In the archive container at the base of the End Throne
jei.focal_decay.source.semantic: First gaze at the Observer Core
jei.focal_decay.source.42ms: Complete the enthronement ritual for the first time

jei.focal_decay.source.aaron: In the relic container left after the Ender Dragon is terminated

jei.focal_decay.note.copy_model: Trainable model + blank model -> 2 copies, original retained. Each recasting reduces coverage; no recasting past the generation cap.
jei.focal_decay.note.feed_fragment: Candidate Observer + any semantic fragment -> progress increases, the fragment is consumed.
jei.focal_decay.derive.semantic_lock: Training Terminal -> select "Semantic Lock" -> right-click with the prototype to record targets -> return and finish training
jei.focal_decay.derive.guided: Training Terminal -> select "Guided Mutation" -> record targets from one concept -> return, finish training and resolve concept q
jei.focal_decay.derive.bio: No training needed; craft it straight from the prototype (see the recipe page)
jei.focal_decay.derive.total_activated: Carry the inactive OBSR-EX to the End Throne and complete the enthronement ritual
jei.focal_decay.derive.candidate: Crafting yields the candidate body. Right-click to record targets, or combine with semantic fragments to inject knowledge
jei.focal_decay.info.prototype: OBSR Prototype: an untrained blank classifier. It has no function of its own, only a writable record table.
jei.focal_decay.info.total_inactive: OBSR-EX (inactive): its parameters are hard-wired and can only be loaded by completing the enthronement ritual at the End Throne.
jei.focal_decay.info.bio: OBSR-Health: no training needed. It runs on the life of nearby creatures, and stops once its energy is spent.
jei.focal_decay.info.anchor: Observer Base: insert an OBSR model to stabilize the surrounding area. With no model inserted it does nothing at all.
jei.focal_decay.info.terminal: Training Terminal: insert an OBSR prototype and pick a training direction. The prototype can be taken out and carried while recording targets, then returned to finish training.
message.focal_decay.ritual_started: The ritual has begun. Stay within the Throne's reach.
message.focal_decay.ritual_paused: You left the Throne. Ritual paused.
message.focal_decay.ritual_active: A ritual is already in progress
message.focal_decay.ritual_need_prototyp: An Observer Base is required, or one must already be placed near the Throne
